Regionshospitalet Gødstrup is a regional hospital operating within [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] in Denmark [^src3]. It is one of the healthcare institutions evaluated in the 2022–2023 annual report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark), which monitors clinical quality and treatment standards for patients with atrial fibrillation across the national healthcare system [^src1]. 

During the reporting period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the hospital was assessed across multiple clinical quality indicators. For [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who undergo echocardiography, Regionshospitalet Gødstrup achieved a compliance rate of 86.4% (95% CI: 83.7–88.7), successfully meeting the national standard [^src2]. Furthermore, regarding [[indikator-4a|Indikator 4a]], which tracks anticoagulation treatment coverage, the hospital reported that 93.3% (95% CI: 77.9–99.2) of eligible patients received the appropriate treatment [^src3]. The hospital's data is also tracked for other clinical metrics, such as the incidence of heart failure following an atrial fibrillation diagnosis, where it recorded 25 cases out of 353 patients (7.1%, 95% CI: 4.6–10.3) [^src4].
